name: Brakeout Trader v1
summary: This EA implements a breakout trading strategy that identifies price breaking through predefined support and resistance levels or channel boundaries. It enters trades when price breaks out of a consolidation range, aiming to capture momentum-driven moves. The system includes basic risk management with stop loss and take profit levels configured via input parameters.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了突破交易策略，通过识别价格突破预定义的支撑阻力位或通道边界来入场。当价格突破盘整区间时开仓，旨在捕获动量驱动的行情。系统包含基于输入参数配置的止损止盈基本风险管理功能。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于经典突破交易理念，当价格突破近期盘整区间的高点或低点时入场。入场条件为价格突破上方阻力线时做多，突破下方支撑线时做空，突破确认依赖价格行为而非指标过滤。出场条件包括固定止损止盈以及可能的追踪止损机制，止损设在突破区间的对立端以防假突破。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，通过输入参数设定交易量，未见动态仓位调整或基于账户权益的资金管理。资金管理方面较为基础，缺乏最大持仓限制、最大回撤控制等高级风控功能，整体策略逻辑简单直接但风控深度不足。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the classic breakout trading philosophy, entering positions when price breaks above resistance or below support levels of a recent consolidation range. Entry conditions trigger a buy when price breaks above the upper boundary and a sell when price breaks below the lower boundary, with breakout confirmation relying on price action rather than indicator filtering. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit levels, with stop loss placed on the opposite side of the breakout range to protect against false breakouts. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach configured via input parameters, with no dynamic position sizing or equity-based money management observed. Money management is relatively basic, lacking advanced risk controls such as maximum position limits, maximum drawdown thresholds, or equity protection mechanisms, making the overall strategy straightforward but lacking in risk management depth.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, limits max loss per trade

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, locks profit target per trade

parameters.name: BreakoutPeriod
parameters.description: 突破区间计算周期（K线数）

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于识别本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: Magic number for closing, 0 for all positions

parameters.name: Timeframe
parameters.description_en: RSI timeframe, 0 for current chart period

pros: 策略逻辑清晰易懂，经典突破方法有理论支撑
止损设在区间对侧，有效防范假突破风险
参数化设计便于优化和适应不同品种
风险回报比合理（止盈大于止损）
入场规则明确，不存在模棱两可的信号
pros_en: Clear and understandable strategy logic based on well-established breakout theory
Stop loss placed on the opposite side of the range effectively guards against false breakouts
Parameterized design allows optimization and adaptation to different instruments
Reasonable risk-reward ratio with take profit exceeding stop loss
Unambiguous entry rules with no vague signal interpretation
cons: 缺乏突破确认机制（如成交量或收盘价确认），容易遭遇假突破
固定手数不考虑账户规模变化，资金管理粗糙
没有追踪止损功能，可能过早离场或回吐过多利润
缺少最大持仓和回撤控制，多笔亏损时风险暴露大
未考虑点差和滑点影响，在突破时刻点差可能扩大
cons_en: Lacks breakout confirmation mechanisms such as volume or close price confirmation, making it vulnerable to false breakouts
Fixed lot sizing ignores account size changes, resulting in crude money management
No trailing stop functionality may lead to premature exits or excessive profit givebacks
Absence of maximum position and drawdown controls exposes large risk during consecutive losses
Does not account for spread and slippage impacts, which can widen significantly at breakout moments
improvements: 增加突破确认机制，如要求K线收盘价突破或成交量放大确认
实现动态仓位管理，基于账户权益百分比自动调整手数
添加追踪止损功能，在趋势延续时锁定更多利润
增加点差过滤和最大持仓限制，提升风险控制能力
improvements_en: Add breakout confirmation mechanisms such as requiring close price beyond the level or volume surge confirmation
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account equity percentage to automatically adjust lot sizes
Add trailing stop functionality to lock in more profit as trends extend
Introduce spread filtering and maximum position limits to enhance risk control capabilities

risk_points: 固定手数不随账户变化调整，资金管理不够灵活
缺乏假突破过滤机制，可能在震荡市中频繁亏损
没有最大回撤保护和持仓数量限制
risk_points_en: Fixed lot sizing does not adapt to account changes, making money management inflexible
Lacks false breakout filtering, potentially causing frequent losses in ranging markets
No maximum drawdown protection or position count limits

The system includes basic risk management with stop loss and take profit levels configured via input parameters.
